title: Delegation summary note: the numeric-range walk-back treats a preceding label number as a range and hides the note for 'Round 2: two issues remain'
outcome: In src/delegation_result_parser.rs (~:480), the ForNote count check walks back over a numeric range even when the counting token is a word number, and it cannot tell ':' from '-' because tokenization drops separators. So 'Round 2: two issues remain.' or 'Step 3: 2 issues remain.' walk back to the label word and the count is taken as a step label: no inconsistency note, and a packet without a preamble looks clean. Only the advisory note is affected; AsBefore findings recovery is unchanged. Fix direction: walk back only from a numeric token, ideally only across a kept '-' separator; add both summaries to the note-positive test.
acceptance: Delegation summary note: the numeric-range walk-back treats a preceding label number as a range and hides the note for 'Round 2: two issues remain' is done
